scope: Issue #18 production implementation plus controlled r8 acceptance harness

findings.evidence: The fenced finalization transaction samples PostgreSQL time and proves the claim at entry, then performs configuration/resource locks, derivation writes, activation CAS and attempt closure using the original database_now value without a fresh lease check immediately before commit.
findings.problem: Finalization does not revalidate worker_id, lease_version and the unexpired lease at the commit boundary.
findings.harm: A transaction that outlives the lease can still publish a succeeded activation or superseded outcome from an expired worker, violating live fencing and stale-result safety.
findings.required_follow_up: Add a fresh database-time/token check immediately before activation and attempt closure/commit; return Fenced so tentative derivation writes roll back, with a deterministic expiry-during-finalization harness oracle.

findings.evidence: The application CitationProjection and PostgreSQL retrieval candidate carry page_start, page_end, start_offset and end_offset, but CitationResponse does not declare those fields. A controlled HTTP probe therefore drops all four PDF locator values from the public response.
findings.problem: The HTTP question contract loses the canonical PDF physical-page and normalized-text offset provenance.
findings.harm: Clients cannot verify the locked PDF citation oracle through the existing HTTP question seam, and TC-01 citation evidence is incomplete even though internal projections contain the locator.
findings.required_follow_up: Expose the four nullable locator fields in CitationResponse and add a contract test preserving nulls for legacy Markdown/text citations.

evidence: 30 focused acceptance-harness tests passed before the final vector-count addition; 31 focused tests pass after it

no_issue_areas: ObjectStore metadata verification and bounded source reads
remote provider/extractor work outside finalization transactions
atomic derivation persistence and activation CAS
duplicate delivery, operation replay, definite rollback and supersession
